overview: Copie Past-e is a production-grade cross-listing platform for resellers. Create one master listing and prepare platform-specific drafts for Facebook Marketplace, Mercari, eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Etsy. The Chrome extension autofills each platform's form so you can manually post anywhere with one click — your data, your control.
features: Master Listing as single source of truth — one item, all platforms
Platform-specific draft editor with real-time field validation and character limits
Chrome extension autofill for 6 marketplaces (Facebook, Mercari, eBay, Poshmark, Depop, Etsy)
Manual-only posting — extension fills forms, you decide when to submit
Platform filter tabs on dashboard showing draft and posting status per marketplace
Audit trail tracking all listing and draft changes
Admin panel with audit log, stats, and system diagnostics
